Anya Patel: Quick q — planning to flip a `route_priority` runtime flag that biases cheaper model variants for low-value requests. Want to do a safe rollout with a telemetry gate and an automatic rollback if quota/latency moves. Anyone seen surprises with similar routing changes?

Ryan Chen: TL;DR yes, watch tail latency and per-route quota spikes. Cheaper variants can have higher 95p LLM latency under burst. :eyes:

Maria Gomez: We're using a two-step gate: dry-run shadow traffic + sampling-based metric checks. If error-rate or SLO breaches, auto-pause. Works well for prefix-cache changes.

Sam Ortiz: +1 to shadowing. Also add a short bleed-in (1% -> 5% -> 20% over 30m) and require both: (a) no error-rate delta > 0.5% and (b) token-cost drop >= 8% to proceed.

Anya Patel: Example rollout plan I sketched:
```yaml
- step: dry-run-shadow
  pct: 0
  duration: 15m
- step: bleed
  pct: [1,5,20]
  duration: 10m each
- telemetry-gates:
  metrics:
    - name: route_error_rate
      max_delta: 0.005
    - name: route_95p_latency_ms
      max_delta: 50
    - name: token_cost_perk
      min_delta: 0.08
- rollback: auto-pause on gate-fail
```

Ryan Chen: Couple implementation notes: console needs to surface which metric failed and the window used. Ops wants to be able to manually pause the rollout from the rollout row (one-click).

DevX Lead: We should also show expected cost delta estimate in the UI before starting (based on recent traffic). Engineers react badly to a rollout they can't estimate.

Maria Gomez: For telemetry sampling, prefer reservoir sampling by request-id not uniform random; otherwise small clients get noisy signals.

Kevin H: deploy-bot: started config rollout preview for `route_priority` -> shadow run created (id: rp-20250311-9) :rocket:

deploy-bot: preview: rp-20250311-9 status=shadowing samples=5k window=15m

Sam Ortiz: Ops checklist: add an alert that is distinct from global SLO alerts (label: rollout_handoff) and route it to #eng-oncall and the rollout owner. Keep incident noise low — use 10m aggregation.

Anya Patel: Action items I can take: (1) add the UI cost-estimate hook (DevX story) (2) wire reservoir sampling for telemetry (Maria + Sam) (3) add auto-pause + clear failure reason to the rollout record (Ryan + Kevin). Anyone want to claim ownership?

Ryan Chen: I'll own (3) with Kevin. Will add an API contract: `POST /rollouts/{id}/pause` and the console will call it with reason.

DevX Lead: I'll scope the UI change; small prototype in Console with mock cost delta and a failure reason banner. We should also expose the exact query used for the gate so SREs can replay it.

Maria Gomez: I'll pair with Sam on reservoir sampling and the telemetry thresholds. We should add a canary window metric to spot slow drifts (30m rolling median).

Kevin H: FYI — ops policy: auto-pauses must require a secondary owner approval to resume when the pause is triggered by quota breach. Not a blocker but heads-up.

Anya Patel: Great. I'll add a short runbook snippet to the rollout template: how to inspect the failed metric, quick revert steps, and who to notify. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
